caseStudies.label: Case Studies
caseStudies.title: Complete studies with real metrics
caseStudies.subtitle: Problem, approach, impact, and stack for each system. Each case focuses on performance, data, and reliability.

items.title: Predict & Analytics Engine
items.outcome: Continuous data ingestion and normalization pipeline
items.problem: Needed to unify external data and on-chain data into a consistent and fast flow.
items.approach: Built asynchronous ingestion, idempotent normalization, enrichment layers, and APIs for real-time dashboards.
items.impact: Reduced complexity, centralized indicators, and enabled fast analytics.

items.title: Wallet Intersection Engine
items.outcome: Intersection of large wallet sets in seconds
items.problem: Campaign analysis required fast, traceable wallet intersections.
items.approach: Implemented async job system, MongoDB aggregations, and pagination for 10k+ wallets.
items.impact: Processes that took hours became seconds, with full transparency.

items.title: Token Analytics Pipeline
items.problem: Needed to analyze tokens and creators without browsing raw data.
items.approach: Created enrichment, compression, and standardized normalization pipelines.
items.impact: Enabled detection of suspicious creators and emerging tokens.

about.label: About me
about.title: Technology, purpose, and real projects
about.subtitle: I combine curiosity and method to create elegant digital experiences with clean code and real-world impact.
paragraphs: I'm a backend and full stack developer with 4+ years building production systems. Strong focus on Node.js, TypeScript, REST APIs and automation. I also work with Web3, having built on-chain pipelines, wallet analysis tools and Solana integrations. Each project represents my growth in engineering, architecture and delivering real value.
In the past few years, I built data systems, dashboards, smart pipelines, enrichment engines, and Web3 automations. Each project represents growth in engineering, architecture, and product thinking.
My motivation is helping people, building real products, and turning complexity into clarity.
